Those procedures, and the associated procedure codes, are: Arthrodesis or Arthroplasty, Interphalangeal Joint, Second-Fifth Toes CPT codes: 28285, 28286 Arthroscopy or Arthroscopically Assisted Surgery, Wrist CPT codes: 25628, 25685, 25695, 29843, 29844, 29845, 29846, 29847 Arthroscopy, Surgical, Ankle CPT codes: 29891, 29892, 29894, 29895, 29897, 29898, 29904, 29905, 29906, 29907 Arthrotomy, Wrist CPT codes: 25040, 25101, 25105, 25107, 25115, 25118, 25119, 25608, 25609, 25645, 25670, 25676 Osteotomy, Distal Transpositional, First Metatarsal (MT) (Bunionectomy) CPT codes: 28296, 28299 Osteotomy, Proximal, First Metatarsal (MT) (Bunionectomy) CPT codes: 28295, 28297, 28298 Plantar Fascial Release CPT codes: 28008, 28060, 28062, 28250, 29893 Reduction and Fixation, Radius +/- Ulna Shaft CPT codes: 25500, 25505, 25515, 25520, 25525, 25526, 25530, 25545, 25560, 25565, 25574, 25575 Authorization coding documentation is available at upmchp.us/PriorAuth as well as the auth entry/inquiry page on Provider OnLine. If you have any questions or concerns about this matter, please contact your physician account executive or call Provider Services at 1-866-918-1595. Providers are responsible for appropriate billing of services. These suggested codes are not meant to provide or supersede clinical judgment. An authorization is not a guarantee of payment for services rendered.
